author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Before was the same H/M frame on tiny wheels as the 165 variant and did not match this reference; redrawn with large r8 wheels, seat post from the rear hub through the rim with a kink under the saddle, top tube to the fork, fork from the front hub through the rim to a forward-hooked handlebar.
omissions: Hub stubs stop just short of the hub centres to keep clearance from the rim.
